title: Specialty Pharmacy Program Refund Standard: Overpayments on Fills Twelve or More Months Old
content:
**Standard.** Under the Specialty Pharmacy Program, an overpayment is returned rather than set against the open balance, as follows. The older fills are those shipped 12 or more whole months before today, and the older payments are those dated 12 or more whole months before today.

- When the member's own older payments together with the program's older payments exceed the older fills' cost share, while the program's older payments alone do not, the member's excess is returned to the member.
- When the program's older payments alone exceed the older fills' cost share, the program's excess is returned to the program.
- Otherwise nothing is returned.

**Terms.**

- **The program's older payments** are the older payments posted on the enrollment by a manufacturer program or a foundation, meaning every older payment that is not the member's own.
- **The member's excess** is the amount by which the member's and the program's older payments together exceed the older fills' cost share.
- **The program's excess** is the amount by which the program's older payments alone exceed that cost share.
- **Whole months.** The number of whole months between a date and today is the count of calendar months from that date to today, less one when today's day of the month is earlier than that date's day of the month. A fill or payment 12 or more whole months back is older.

## Ladder

| Program's older payments compared with older fills' cost share | Member's and program's older payments together compared with that cost share | Returned |
|---|---|---|
| not more | more | the member's excess, returned to the member |
| more | (necessarily more) | the program's excess, returned to the program |
| not more | not more | nothing |

## Worked cases (assumed figures for older fills and payments)

| Older fills' cost share | Member's older payments | Program's older payments | Returned |
|---|---|---|---|
| $500.00 | $150.00 | $400.00 | $50.00 to the member |
| $500.00 | $30.00 | $500.00 | $30.00 to the member; the program's $500.00 does not exceed $500.00 |
| $500.00 | $100.00 | $520.00 | $20.00 to the program |
| $500.00 | $100.00 | $400.00 | nothing; together they equal $500.00 |

## Which items are older (assumed today 2026-10-08)

A fill shipped 2025-10-08 lies 12 whole months back and is older. A fill shipped 2025-10-09 lies 11 whole months back and is not older.
